detail.command:
printf '
=== STATUS ===
'; git status --short; printf '
=== PACKAGE ===
'; cat package.json; printf '
=== SRC TREE ===
'; find src -maxdepth 4 -type f | sort; printf '
=== PUBLIC CONTRACTS / CONFIG ===
'; find src -maxdepth 4 -type f \( -path '*/contracts/*' -o -path '*/config/*' -o -path '*/types/*' \) -print -exec sh -c 'echo "--- $1"; sed -n "1,240p" "$1"' _ {} \;
